import concurrent.futures,hashlib,json,time,urllib.request,urllib.error,urllib.parse
from datetime import datetime,timezone
class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
 def redirect_request(self,*args,**kwargs): return None
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),NoRedirect())
end=time.time_ns();query='sum(count_over_time({namespace="apps-staging",container="yfinance-wrapper"}[60s]))'
targets=[('mimir','http://mimir-gateway.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:80/prometheus/api/v1/query?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'query':'up{namespace="apps-staging",job="yfinance-wrapper"}'})),('loki','http://loki.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:3100/loki/api/v1/query?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'query':query,'time':str(end)})),('tempo','http://tempo.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:3200/api/v2/traces/5bc9c8913a4d880a09cf1de1fccb5200?start=1788649500&end=1788649800'),('yfinance-health','http://yfinance-wrapper.apps-staging.svc.cluster.local:8090/healthz'),('frontend-config','http://finance-frontend.apps-staging.svc.cluster.local:8080/runtime-config.json')]
def read(item):
 name,url=item;started=time.monotonic();record={'name':name,'method':'GET','url':url}
 try:
  with opener.open(urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Accept':'application/json'}),timeout=15) as response:
   raw=response.read(262145);assert len(raw)<=262144
   body=json.loads(raw);record.update({'http_status':response.status,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
   if name in ('mimir','loki'):
    assert body['status']=='success';rows=body['data']['result'];assert rows and len(rows)<=32
    samples=[float(r['value'][1]) for r in rows];assert all(v>0 for v in samples)
    record.update({'series':len(rows),'positive_samples':True})
   elif name=='tempo':
    assert body.get('status',0) in (0,'COMPLETE') and not body.get('message')
    batches=body['trace']['resourceSpans'];assert 0<len(batches)<=8
    record['resource_batches']=len(batches)
   elif name=='yfinance-health':assert body=={'status':'ok'}
   else:
    assert body['schemaVersion']==1 and body['environment']=='staging'
    record['environment']='staging'
   record['state']='passed'
 except Exception as e:
  record.update({'state':'inconclusive','error_type':type(e).__name__})
 record['elapsed_ms']=round((time.monotonic()-started)*1000);return record
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as pool:results=list(pool.map(read,targets))
print(json.dumps({'observed_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'namespace':'pharness','service_account':'pharness-api','service_account_token_mounted':False,'results':results,'scope':'Routing and bounded response presence from a separate in-cluster Job only. No API image or RBAC deployment, exact native reader execution, runtime window, production action or hosted acceptance.'}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if all(r['state']=='passed' for r in results) else 1)
